shots.image: Night, front door of a small cozy suburban house: the burglar crouches, lifting the doormat and holding up a key he just found, huge grin.
shots.animate: He lifts the doormat, picks up the key and grins.

shots.image: Evening, front door of a small cozy house: Gérard slides a key under the doormat, very pleased with his idea, winking.
shots.animate: Gérard slides the key under the mat, pats it, stands up and winks.

shots.image: Evening, Gérard coming home with a grocery bag, bending down and lifting the doormat to take the key, happy.
shots.animate: He lifts the mat, takes the key and opens the door with a satisfied smile.

shots.image: Night, the burglar walks along a street of houses, lifting each doormat and checking under it with a flashlight, methodical.
shots.animate: He lifts one doormat, checks with his flashlight, puts it back and moves to the next door.

shots.image: Night, the burglar opens the front door of the cozy house with the key on the first try, door swinging open, he tiptoes in.
shots.animate: He turns the key, the door swings open and he tiptoes inside.

shots.image: Day, a completely empty living room with bare walls, Gérard in the doorway with his jaw dropped, Biscotte the fat orange tabby cat sitting alone in the middle of the floor.
shots.animate: Gérard's jaw drops and he looks around in shock; the cat yawns.

shots.image: Day, in front of a house door, Inès shows a small black key lock box with a keypad mounted on the wall, confident smile.
shots.animate: Inès opens the key box, puts a key inside, closes it and smiles.

shots.image: Day, front door: Gérard proudly hides the key under a flower pot next to the door, Inès behind him facepalming.
shots.animate: Gérard tucks the key under the flower pot and gives a thumbs up; Inès slowly facepalms.
